# volcano_user_git_connections (Data Source)

The account's git provider connections (e.g. a GitHub App installation owner), used as the connection_id for volcano_project_git_connection. Connecting a new one requires an interactive OAuth/installation flow this provider cannot drive - manage that through the dashboard or CLI, then reference the result here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "volcano_user_git_connections" "all" {}
```
